subject: planner: try to match universal bindings when optimization (#49475)
summary: Refactors statement normalization into separate plan-cache vs binding paths, introduces `tidb_opt_enable_universal_binding` (session/global) to gate universal binding matching, and extends optimizer binding lookup to try session/global universal bindings after normal bindings (priority: session normal > session universal > global normal > global universal), while filtering out records with no enabled bindings.
